scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana (Solar Fencing & Protection)
description: Integrated scheme offering subsidies for solar fencing, interlink chain fencing, anti-hail nets, and polyhouse greenhouse renovation to protect crops against monkeys, wild animals, and severe hail damage.
benefits: 80% subsidy for individual farmers and 85% subsidy for group farming (3 or more farmers) on solar power fencing; 80% assistance for anti-hail nets up to 5,000 sq m; 70% assistance for greenhouse polyhouse sheet replacement.
eligibility: Permanent resident farmers of Himachal Pradesh owning cultivable land
Priority provided to small, marginal, and hill-region farmers

description: Promotes chemical-free Zero Budget Natural Farming (ZBNF) by supporting indigenous (Desi) cow purchase, bio-input preparation kits, cattle shed lining, and farm-level input shops.
benefits: 50% subsidy up to ₹25,000 (plus ₹5,000 transport allowance) for purchasing indigenous cows; ₹8,000 for cattle shed lining; ₹2,250 for plastic drums; and one-time assistance of ₹50,000 over 3 years for setting up natural input shops.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Himachal Pradesh committed to adopting non-chemical natural farming practices
documents: Desi Cow Ownership / Purchase Bill (for cow subsidy)
application_mode: Online / Offline via State Natural Farming Portal (spnfhp.in) or ATMA Block Offices

description: Supports cluster-based development in agriculture and allied sectors by linking farm production with processing, storage, branding, and direct market linkage.
benefits: Financial grants and technical assistance up to 80% for forming farmer clusters, establishing common facility centers, and value addition infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmer Self-Help Groups (SHGs), Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and smallholder clusters in Himachal Pradesh
documents: List of Member Farmers with Land Records
Aadhaar Cards of Key Office Bearers
application_mode: Online via HP Agriculture Portal / District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Jal Se Krishi Ko Bal Yojana
description: Focuses on constructing small check dams, farm ponds, and community lift irrigation or flow irrigation schemes to harness water sources in hilly terrains.
benefits: 100% state funding for community check dam construction and up to 80% financial assistance for individual lift irrigation pumpsets and piping.
eligibility: Individual farmers or community groups of farmers in rainfed agricultural regions of Himachal Pradesh
documents: NOC from Gram Panchayat / Irrigation Source Access Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Block Development / Agriculture Officer or Online via eDistrict HP

scheme_name: Krishi Se Sampannta Yojana (Hing and Saffron Cultivation)
description: Promotes commercial cultivation of high-value cash crops like Asafoetida (Hing) and Saffron in suitable high-altitude regions (Chamba, Lahaul-Spiti, Kinnaur, Kullu).
benefits: Free supply of high-quality planting material (corms/seeds), 75% subsidy on specialized soil inputs, and free technical guidance from CSIR-IHBT Palampur.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in notified high-altitude agro-climatic zones of Himachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline application through District Agriculture Extension Offices

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Green House Renovation & Polyhouse Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides capital subsidies for constructing new polyhouses and replacing worn-out poly-sheets/UV films after 5 years or following natural calamity damage.
benefits: 85% subsidy for establishing polyhouse/greenhouse structures and 70% assistance for poly-sheet replacement.
eligibility: Horticulture and vegetable growers residing in Himachal Pradesh with eligible land titles
documents: Polyhouse Site Map and Cost Estimate

description: Encourages rural women and small farmers to set up backyard poultry units and commercial broilers/layers to boost subsidiary income.
benefits: 60% to 75% subsidy on purchasing day-old chicks, poultry feed, and night-shelter cage construction for 100 to 500 bird units.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh; priority given to BPL families, Women SHGs, and SC/ST farmers
application_mode: Online via eDistrict Himachal / Offline at Veterinary Hospitals

description: Offers direct price incentive bonuses per liter to dairy farmers selling cow and buffalo milk through organized cooperative societies.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) price support subsidy directly into farmers' bank accounts based on milk fat content and quantity logged by cooperatives.
eligibility: Milk producers registered with primary dairy cooperative societies in Himachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline registration through local Dairy Cooperative Society / HP MILKFED

scheme_name: Anti-Hail Net Scheme for Apple & Fruit Orchards
description: Subsidizes high-density anti-hail nets to safeguard high-value apple, plum, peach, and cherry orchards from summer hailstorms.
benefits: 80% subsidy on the purchase of government-approved anti-hail nets up to a maximum area of 5,000 square meters per beneficiary.
eligibility: Orchard owners and fruit growers with registered land in Himachal Pradesh
documents: Jamabandi Land Extract showing orchard status
application_mode: Online via HP Horticulture DBT Portal

scheme_name: Inland Fisheries & Trout Farming Promotion Scheme
description: Promotes cold-water trout farming and carp culture by providing capital subsidies for raceway construction, trout hatcheries, fish feed, and solar aerators.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries on trout unit construction cost (up to ₹3,30,000 per unit).
eligibility: Fish farmers and unemployed youth residing in cold-water stream regions of Himachal Pradesh with land and water flow availability
documents: Land Ownership Document or 10-year Lease Deed
Water Availability / NOC Certificate from Jal Shakti Department
application_mode: Offline / Online via HP Fisheries Department Portal
